visual_grammar.medium_handling: Opaque heraldic pigment, burnished gold-leaf accents, manuscript border geometry, and fine civic ink detail over parchment.
visual_grammar.composition: Frontal, symmetrical, emblematic civic staging: thrones, ledgers, gates, halls, markets, seals, and governed spaces arranged like coins, charters, or illuminated legal pages.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Clean heraldic silhouettes, ruled architectural boundaries, repeated border motifs, and precise ink contours softened only by parchment texture.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Warm parchment and ordered mid-values anchored by royal blue/dark ink, with gold used as hierarchy rather than ambient glow.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Frontal medium-to-wide civic view with little perspectival distortion; institutions and spaces feel stable, inspectable, and publicly accountable.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Fine detail gathers on seals, ledgers, regalia, façades, thresholds, and evidence of stewardship; large governed masses stay calm and legible.
visual_grammar.finish: Formal, burnished, civic, and manuscript-like—the visual grammar of something recorded under seal.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Dark carved/woodcut-like ink over matte iron-gray and blood-red pigment, with dry hatching, scraped highlights, and forceful diagonal strokes.
visual_grammar.composition: Kinetic diagonals, pursuits, clashes, dungeon passages, and exposed roads; figures are caught mid-strike, mid-flight, or at the instant courage becomes action.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Hard cut silhouettes, aggressive hatch direction, broken carved contours, and sharp weapon/terrain intersections.
visual_grammar.value_structure: High contrast from cave/storm dark to pale blade/impact highlights, with restrained red used as heat, wound, or urgency.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Low or eye-level action view, medium-to-wide enough to show path, foe, and consequence; space is something crossed or fought through.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Precision concentrates at weapon, foe, wound, path, and immediate terrain; surrounding darkness is cut in broad graphic masses.
visual_grammar.finish: Biting, kinetic, manual-illustration woodcut energy rather than polished combat concept art.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Deep indigo and matte pigment on vellum with luminous gold-ink/runic penwork, candle-warm glazing, and flattened iconographic fields.
visual_grammar.composition: Page-like, centered or vertically ordered sacred space: books, runes, shrines, diagrams, spells, and contemplative figures arranged as if knowledge itself were illuminated.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Angular glyph lines, precise marginal marks, flat icon contours, and small gold-lit details against saturated manuscript fields.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Deep indigo/dark vellum fields support concentrated gold and candle-white marks; the brightest values belong to legible knowledge.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Flattened iconographic or near-orthographic interior view; depth is subordinate to textual/symbolic hierarchy.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: High detail in runes, diagrams, written margins, books, and ritual objects; surrounding planes remain controlled and sacred.
visual_grammar.finish: Illuminated, learned, devotional, and slightly severe—the page as a vessel of fixed wisdom.

visual_grammar.medium_handling: Translucent indigo, moon-silver, and phosphor-red glazing over matte night pigment, with soft halo edges and reflected-water washes.
visual_grammar.composition: Rounded passages, arches, circles, crossings, companionship, reflective water, and open nocturnal roads; forms curve around portals and transitions rather than locking into rigid frames.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Soft haloed contours, reflected/doubled edges, rounded arches, water-softened boundaries, and occasional crisp threshold silhouettes.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Deep nocturnal ground with small luminous gates/moons/reflections; light pools rather than spreads evenly.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Medium or wide dream-road view with enough depth for passage from here to there; often low horizon or reflected plane.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Detail gathers at gate edges, companions, moons, reflections, and objects crossing thresholds; darkness and water simplify the rest.
visual_grammar.finish: Luminous nocturne—tender, liminal, reflective, and mobile without becoming soft-focus fantasy wallpaper.
avoid: flat manuscript page geometry as the dominant structure
